title: Sphere Circles
desc: Tangential circles orbiting a sphere — full controls on desktop, a touch-friendly phone app you can install.

changelog.notes: Full 360° Orbit with a soft pitch rock; long-press Orbit for multi-axis dance speeds.
Toggle circle strokes off in Look, leaving dots when Dots is on.
Put Circles and Phase first in the Motion dock sheet.
Fix PWA install when opened from Aaron's Apps hub.
Idle play wall dashes and unwrap tricks so the flock can lunge, peel open, and wind back into a sphere.
